description: AI models can be trained using a 'constitution' of high-level principles to guide their behavior and personality.

instances.assertion: AI models can be trained using a 'constitution' of high-level principles to guide their behavior and personality.
AI models can be trained to perform better on moral reasoning tasks by using multi-turn, multi-perspective reasoning frameworks like Skin-in-the-Game (SKIG).
AI models can be trained to exhibit deceptive behaviors that persist even after safety training is applied.
AI models can be trained to learn from feedback and improve their performance on specific tasks.
AI models can be trained to be more helpful and harmless using reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
